narrative.overview: An original celestial game screen with a fixed dynamic viewport. A dark environment supports an ivory dossier and gold identity. The home dossier alone scrolls; case studies retain their natural reading layout. Projects has one navigation entry.
keyCharacteristics: Atmospheric blue scenery behind warm ivory dossiers.
Fine pale-gold geometry, inset borders and asymmetric corners.
Original SVG identity and project symbols.
Readable text, real links and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Reading Surface Rule
rules.body: Put extended reading on parchment with dark ink; keep environmental glows and texture subordinate to text.

rules.name: The Identity Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve Cinzel for identity; use Newsreader and Source Sans 3 for readable interface text.

rules.name: The Screen Boundary Rule
rules.body: Keep home at 100dvh, scroll inside the dossier, and use only the Projects tab for project selection.

dos: **Do** use original SVG symbols and the authored monogram for celestial identity.
**Do** keep parchment text selectable, readable and clear of decorative geometry.
**Do** preserve visible labels, keyboard focus, selected-state semantics and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** use actual application captures and explicit project-stage labels.
donts: **Don't** substitute extracted game assets or a screenshot of the approved reference for the interface.
**Don't** turn stars or emblems into unsupported levels, ratings, metrics or awards.
**Don't** replace the reading fonts with ornamental identity typography.
**Don't** trap long content inside a fixed-height game screen or let bottom navigation cover it.
